page.overview:
What is Gladrags Wizardwear?

Gladrags Wizardwear was a clothing store that was founded in 1750 and run by Gladrags Wizardwear Group Ltd., with branches in London, Paris and Hogsmeade. It was full of quirky merchandise and appeared to specialise in strange and unusual socks.

In the early 1890s, Augustus Hill was the shopkeeper of the Hogsmeade branch Augustus was a relentless and very positive salesman who could make unflattering attire sound good. Later in the school year, the student also talked to Otto outside the shop about Theophilus Harlow's blackmail.

Gladrags took out a large billboard-size advertisement at the final of the 1994 Quidditch World Cup, on 15 August.

On 6 March 1995, Harry Potter, Ronald Weasley and Hermione Granger visited the Hogsmeade branch of Gladrags to buy some novelty socks for Dobby's present.
